Part 57 final rule: no evidence it has issued. Sources show only the proposed rule (comments closed June 15, 2026) and the Nov 23, 2026 executive-order target. No primary NRC page confirming current status was fetched, so no Type G check written.
Political or regulatory events dated after 2026-10-27: none found across Congress, NRC, DOE, DoD, states and PUCs. The NCSL October 2026 roundup (dated Oct 23) lists none after Oct 27.

FY2027 NDAA: the House bill (passed July 22, 2026) carries a microreactor amendment for INDOPACOM (sponsor Rep. Pat Harrigan). No Senate microreactor provision was found, and no conference action after Oct 27 was found. The S. 2389 ARMOR Act is not confirmed as attached to any NDAA text.

Minnesota HF 4711 and SF 4901 are bills, not dockets, and predate the window.
